label: rem:hopf-non-cocommutativity
title: Non-cocommutativity of the Hopf structure
html: The Hopf comultiplication \Delta \colon A \to A \otimes A of the Frobenius--Hopf object is coassociative but not cocommutative when q \neq 1. The failure is controlled by the universal R-matrix: \sigma \circ \Delta = \mathrm{Ad}_{R_q} \circ \Delta. This non-cocommutativity provides the algebraic origin of quantum uncertainty, preventing independent observations from commuting.
